fidelity: F2a — Crosswind Pumping-Cycle Physics-Lumped Model with Tether ODE
source: Loyd (1980) J. Energy 4(3):106-111; Fagiano & Milanese (2012) ACC; Schmehl ed. (2018) Airborne Wind Energy, Springer; Luchsinger (2013) in Airborne Wind Energy (Ahrens et al.)

CL.note: Kite lift coefficient at crosswind operating point (Schmehl 2018, soft kite ~1.0)

CD_kite.note: Kite drag coefficient (gives CL/CD=10, consistent with F1a CL_CD=10)

CD_tether.note: Cylinder cross-flow drag coefficient of tether (Re ~1e4-1e5)

L_min.note: Tether length at start of reel-out (minimum)

L_max.note: Tether length at end of reel-out (maximum)

eta_gen.note: Generator + drivetrain efficiency (reel-out, reused from F1a eta_gen)

f_out.note: Reel-out reeling factor f = v_reel/v_wind (Loyd optimum 1/3)

f_in.note: Reel-in reeling factor (retraction speed / wind speed)

gamma_in.note: Effective lift coeff fraction during depowered reel-in (low-drag glide)

P_rated.note: Rated electrical power of ground station (reused from F1a)
